Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ حَظِّيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ
Translation: O Allah, increase my share in it [this day] of voluntary acts of worship
And honor me in it by attending to my requests

Arabic text: وَقَرِّبْ فِيْهِ وَسِيْلَتِيْ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الوَسَائِلِ
Translation: And bring my means of approach to You closer from among all means

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ إِلْحَاحُ المُلِحّينَ
Translation: O You who is not distracted by the persistence of those who persist
